verdict.rationale: Teams can be driven without its UI. Microsoft Graph lets services running outside the Teams experience automate teams, channels and message posting (docs-19, docs-8, docs-35, docs-11). The official Agents Toolkit CLI covers provisioning, deployment, validation, packaging and publishing (docs-16, docs-23, docs-24, probe-4). However, nothing documents CI usage specifically, and a community user notes automation requires the full Azure/Graph stack (comm-11). Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD or non-interactive auth guidance for the CLI, a documented headless run mode, independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.
